quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #6
										  					
  

36 Questions • Passing Score 30

questions.question: On a freeway, you should look farther ahead than on a city street:

options.text: Because your vehicle needs a quarter mile to stop.

questions.explanation: On the freeway, traffic changes quickly. Watch for signals from other drivers. Be ready for vehicles entering at on-ramps and for sudden changes in road conditions.

questions.question: Which statement is true about drugs and driving?

options.text: Prescription drugs are safe if you don't feel drowsy.
Over-the-counter drugs can impair your driving.

questions.correctAnswerText: Over-the-counter drugs can impair your driving.
questions.explanation: Prescription and over-the-counter drugs can impair your driving. This includes drugs for colds, allergies, or nerves. The law applies to all drugs that impair driving, whether illegal, prescription, or over-the-counter.

questions.question: You need extra space in front of your vehicle when following a:
questions.explanation: Leave extra space behind a motorcycle. Motorcycles stop faster than other vehicles. You need room to stop if the rider brakes or falls. Also, motorcycles are hard to see at night because they have only one tail light.

questions.question: You have enough space to return to your lane after passing when:

options.text: The other driver signals you to come back.
You look over your shoulder and see the other car behind you.
You can see both headlights of the passed car in your rearview mirror.

questions.correctAnswerText: You can see both headlights of the passed car in your rearview mirror.
questions.explanation: Make sure there is a safe gap before you return to your lane. When you see both headlights in your rearview mirror, it is safe to move back into your lane.

questions.question: On the freeway behind a large truck, you should drive:

options.text: Closer than you would behind a car.
Farther away than you would behind a car.
To the right side and wait to pass.

questions.correctAnswerText: Farther away than you would behind a car.
questions.explanation: Follow a large truck from farther away than a car. Trucks have larger blind spots and you need more stopping distance.

questions.question: You agree to a chemical test for alcohol when you:
questions.explanation: By driving in California, you automatically agree to breath, blood, or urine testing if arrested for suspicion of drunk or drugged driving.

questions.question: This road sign means:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you of an intersection ahead so you can prepare for turns or changes in traffic.

questions.question: On a green arrow, you must:

options.text: Yield to vehicles, bicycles, and pedestrians in the intersection.

questions.correctAnswerText: Yield to vehicles, bicycles, and pedestrians in the intersection.
questions.explanation: A green arrow means "go." Turn in the direction of the arrow after you yield to any vehicles, bicycles, or pedestrians in the intersection.

questions.question: To keep traction on wet roads, you should:
questions.explanation: Reduce your speed on wet roads and keep your tires in good condition to prevent hydroplaning. If you lose control, take your foot off the gas, don't brake, stay straight, and let the vehicle slow down naturally.

questions.question: If you see a pedestrian with a guide dog or white cane:
questions.explanation: A white cane or guide dog indicates a blind or partially blind pedestrian. You must yield the right-of-way to these pedestrians.

questions.question: A flashing yellow traffic light means:

options.text: Stop if you can do so safely.
Stop and yield to all traffic.

questions.explanation: A flashing yellow light warns you to proceed with caution. Slow down and watch for pedestrians, bicyclists, and vehicles before entering the intersection.

questions.question: Safely backing your vehicle requires all of the following, except:
questions.explanation: Backing is dangerous because you cannot see behind your vehicle. Check your surroundings before you enter the vehicle. Look over your shoulder as you back up.

questions.question: Animals in the back of a pickup truck must be:

options.text: In a truck bed at least 18 inches high.

questions.explanation: Animals must be properly secured in the truck bed to prevent them from falling, jumping, or being thrown out.

questions.question: "No passing zone" signs mean:

options.text: It is not safe to pass.

questions.correctAnswerText: It is not safe to pass.
questions.explanation: You cannot pass in a "No passing zone." These areas have limited visibility and passing would be unsafe.

questions.question: When you see an octagonal sign, you must:
questions.explanation: An octagonal sign always means "Stop." Come to a complete stop, yield to traffic and pedestrians, and proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: When merging onto the freeway, drive:

options.text: At or near the speed of freeway traffic.
5 to 10 mph slower than freeway traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: At or near the speed of freeway traffic.
questions.explanation: Merge onto the freeway at or near the speed of traffic.

questions.question: At a railroad crossing with no warning devices and you cannot see 400 feet down the tracks, the speed limit is:
questions.explanation: Within 100 feet of a railroad crossing where you cannot see 400 feet in both directions, the speed limit is 15 mph. You may drive faster if the crossing has gates, warning signals, or a flagger.

questions.question: For a right turn from a highway with two lanes in your direction, turn from:

options.text: The lane closest to the center.
The lane nearest the curb or edge.

questions.correctAnswerText: The lane nearest the curb or edge.
questions.explanation: Begin and end your right turn in the lane nearest the right curb. Do not swing into another lane.

questions.question: What should you do when driving in fog?

options.text: Turn on your high beam headlights.
Slow down and use your low beam headlights.
Speed up so you do not cause an accident.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and use your low beam headlights.
questions.explanation: In fog, slow down and use your low beams. If you cannot see ahead, pull off the road and wait for the fog to clear.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed. You may see this sign at intersections with heavy oncoming traffic.

questions.question: What is the speed limit at an uncontrolled railroad crossing?
questions.explanation: Within 100 feet of an uncontrolled railroad crossing where you cannot see the tracks for 400 feet in both directions, the speed limit is 15 mph.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A steep hill or downgrade is ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: A steep hill or downgrade is ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you of a steep downgrade or hill ahead. The hill may be long, steep, or have sharp curves.

questions.question: What does a broken yellow line between two lanes mean?

options.text: Both lanes go in the same direction.
You can pass when it is safe.

questions.correctAnswerText: You can pass when it is safe.
questions.explanation: Dashed yellow lines separate lanes of traffic moving in opposite directions. You can pass when there is no oncoming traffic.

questions.question: If dust or smoke blocks your view of other vehicles, what should you turn on?
questions.explanation: Turn on your headlights whenever you cannot see other vehicles. This helps other drivers see you too.

questions.question: When should you use turn signals when parking next to a curb?

options.text: Only when pulling up to the curb.
Both when pulling up to and leaving the curb.

questions.correctAnswerText: Both when pulling up to and leaving the curb.
questions.explanation: Use your turn signal when pulling up to a curb and when leaving the curb.

questions.question: When should you not enter an intersection if it will be blocked when the light turns red?

options.text: Unless you entered on a yellow light.
Unless you entered on a green light.

questions.explanation: Even if the light is green, do not enter an intersection unless you can get completely across before the light turns red. Blocking an intersection can result in a citation.

questions.question: What lights should you use when daylight starts to fade?
questions.explanation: As daylight fades, turn on your low beams so others can see you. Only use high beams when no other drivers are nearby.

questions.question: Is it illegal to leave a child age six or younger alone in a vehicle?

options.text: Yes, even if they are in a child car seat.
No, if someone age 12 or older is with them.
Only if the car key is in the ignition.

questions.correctAnswerText: Yes, even if they are in a child car seat.
questions.explanation: Never leave a child age six or younger alone in a vehicle. A child may stay in a vehicle if supervised by someone age 12 or older.

questions.question: At a four-way stop, you and the driver on your left arrive at the same time. Who has the right-of-way?
questions.explanation: At a four-way stop, when two vehicles arrive at the same time, the vehicle on the right has the right-of-way.

questions.question: On a one-way street with multiple lanes, which lane should you use to turn left onto another one-way street?

options.text: Any lane, as long as it is safe.

questions.explanation: When turning left from a one-way street onto another one-way street, start the turn from the far left lane.

questions.question: What color are traffic control devices in construction work zones?
questions.explanation: Orange signs, cones, and barriers mark work zones. Be extra careful when you see orange warning signs on the road.

questions.question: What does a 55 mph speed limit sign mean?

options.text: You must travel through the intersection at 55 mph.
The maximum speed limit under normal conditions is 55 mph.
You must not drive slower than 55 mph.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum speed limit under normal conditions is 55 mph.
questions.explanation: A speed limit sign shows the maximum speed allowed under normal conditions. You can drive slower based on road conditions, but you cannot drive faster than the posted limit.

questions.question: When can you legally block an intersection?

options.text: If you entered on a green light.

questions.explanation: Even if the light is green, do not enter an intersection unless you can get completely across before the light turns red. Blocking an intersection can result in a citation.

questions.question: When planning to pass another vehicle, what should you remember?

options.text: Do not assume other drivers will make room for you.
The driver will let you pass if you signal.
The driver will keep the same speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Do not assume other drivers will make room for you.
questions.explanation: When passing, do not count on having enough time or assume other drivers will make room for you. When you see both headlights of the passed vehicle in your rearview mirror, you have enough room to return to your lane.

questions.question: When must you always stop before crossing railroad tracks?

options.text: When there is not enough room on the other side for your vehicle to completely cross.
When the crossing is in a city with frequent train traffic.
When you are carrying young children.

questions.correctAnswerText: When there is not enough room on the other side for your vehicle to completely cross.
questions.explanation: A train can come on any track at any time. Make sure your entire vehicle clears the tracks before you stop.

questions.question: What should you do if your vehicle loses traction on wet roads?

options.text: Drive at a constant speed to grip the road better.
Slow down gradually without using the brakes.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down gradually without using the brakes.
questions.explanation: When driving on wet roads at speeds as low as 30 mph, your tires may ride on water instead of gripping the road. This is called hydroplaning. If this happens, slow down gradually and do not apply the brakes.
